tour_scenarios.name: automatic_tour_then_scrolly
tour_scenarios.description: After entry: the ORIGINAL1 row spins out first for its multiplayer flag, the tour skips the locked row 49 that also has a flag and walks to FOR1 (camera 20 a tick, 10 ticks wait, spin, 90 held, spin in), then finds no more and, with a new main score, restarts as the scrolly table with the static camera, which times out to the main menu.

tour_scenarios.name: automatic_tour_jungle_flag_no_main
tour_scenarios.description: After entry with no new main score: the rewritten jungle row (level 19) is visited for the JUNGLE1 flag; the camera passes four rows; the tour then goes straight to the main menu. FIRE, LEFT and RIGHT are ignored.

tour_scenarios.name: automatic_tour_back
tour_scenarios.description: After entry, TRIANGLE while the camera travels leaves for the main menu at once.

tour_scenarios.name: scrolly_after_entry_back
tour_scenarios.description: The scrolly table not from options: models fly on, TRIANGLE leaves for the main menu and stops the flying.

tour_scenarios.name: manual_from_options
tour_scenarios.description: From options: hold DOWN through the open rows (HOP, then HOP and CROAK each tick at the bottom), UP back, FIRE before and after the box is out, TRIANGLE spins in, LEFT restarts as the scrolly table, RIGHT returns to the stack at ORIGINAL1, FIRE then LEFT while the level is shown, and TRIANGLE leaves for the options page.

tour_scenarios.name: manual_back_while_moving
tour_scenarios.description: From options: TRIANGLE while the camera moves is ignored; once stationary it leaves.

scene_scenarios.name: frog_ping_pong
scene_scenarios.description: Main-menu scrolly camera: the models fly on, the frog waits 18 ticks on turtle 0 and hops up to turtle 9 and back down to turtle 0, then turns north again; the camera follows its z once flying ends.

scene_scenarios.name: fly_on_then_fly_off
scene_scenarios.description: Main-menu scrolly camera: fly on, the frog takes off, a fly-off starts after tick 25 and slides every model and the frog away from x 0 until LEAVE on its tenth tick.

scene_scenarios.name: static_camera
scene_scenarios.description: High-score view camera: the models fly on and settle; the frog stays hidden and still.
